title: Ankhorage Expo Runtime
summary: Provides declarative Expo runtime integration that maps application capabilities to permissions, packages, config plugins, providers, and adapters.
purpose: Enable independently authored applications to realize declared capabilities in Expo environments without coupling portable application definitions to Expo implementation code.
responsibilities: Map supported application capabilities to Expo permissions, packages, config plugins, providers, and adapters.
Publish runtime APIs for capability bridging, planning, platform access, media, OAuth browser handling, barcode scanning, bundled media, and icon fonts.
Provide React Native and browser-compatible package entrypoints for supported Expo runtime integrations.
boundaries: Does not define the portable cross-repository contracts consumed by runtime integrations.
Does not own application-specific screens, business workflows, or deployment operations.
Does not implement providers outside the declared Expo integration surface.
audience: Application authors integrating declared capabilities with Expo.
Maintainers of Expo adapters and runtime integrations.
useCases: Plan Expo dependencies and permissions from declared application capabilities.
Integrate supported media, OAuth browser, barcode scanning, icon-font, and platform runtime behavior.
Bridge application capability invocations to Expo-backed implementations.

architecture.role: Framework-specific runtime integration package translating declared application capabilities into Expo-compatible behavior.
invariants: Portable application contracts remain independent of Expo implementation details.
Framework and platform entrypoints are explicit package subpaths.
Optional Expo integrations remain isolated behind declared capability and provider boundaries.

limitations: Requires compatible Expo, React, React Native, and optional peer packages for the selected integration.
Only the explicitly published runtime entrypoints and supported capabilities are provided.
